title: VTA did:webs DIDs Delete — payload
description: Deactivate a did:webs DID — a rotation to no next keys, published and committed — then remove its slot from the hosting server. Irreversible. Alpha.

expectedVersionId.description: Precondition: the DID's latest event, as `<sequence number>:<SAID>`, that the caller based this deletion on. Refused with `versionConflict` when the DID has moved on. Ignored for a DID already deactivated.

Response.title: VTA did:webs DIDs Delete — response payload

deactivated.description: Always true in a success response: the deactivating rotation is published and committed.

newlyDeactivated.description: True when this request published the deactivating rotation; false when the DID was already deactivated.

versionId.description: The deactivating rotation as `<sequence number>:<SAID>`: the DID's last event.

slotRemoved.description: Whether the hosting server confirmed the slot's removal. False means the DID still resolves, as deactivated, and `hostCleanupError` says why.

hostCleanupError.description: Present exactly when `slotRemoved` is false: what stopped the slot's removal. A consumer of the response MUST surface it. A further delete request retries the removal.
